Belo Corporation]] |pages=1G |via=[[NewsBank]]}} | rebuilt = | accessible = Yes | code = | owned = [[Dallas Area Rapid Transit]] | zone = | service = }} '''Jack Hatchell Transit Center''' is a bus-only [[Public transport|mass transit]] station located at the intersection of W 15th Street and Coit Road in [[Plano, Texas|Plano]], [[Texas]], United States. It is owned and operated by [[Dallas Area Rapid Transit]] (DART). The facility is one of only seven DART facilities to not be located in [[Dallas County, Texas|Dallas County]]. The station and its connecting routes service two Plano-area hospitals ([[Medical City Plano]] and [[Baylor Scott & White Medical Center – Plano|Baylor Medical Center Plano]]) and four DART facilities ([[Addison Transit Center|Addison]], [[Downtown Plano station|Downtown Plano]], [[Forest Lane station|Forest Lane]], and [[Northwest Plano Park & Ride|Northwest Plano]]).{{Cite web |date=2023-01-23 |title=System Map |url=https://dartorgcmsblob.dart.org/prod/docs/default-source/dart-maps/dartsystemmap.pdf |website=[[Dallas Area Rapid Transit]]}} == History == In 1987, DART operated only one facility in Plano, which was a [[Park and ride|park-and-ride]] lot in east Plano. To improve service on the western side of Plano and prevent overcrowding, DART opted to build a new station. The station was opened on January 30, 1989 as '''West Plano Transit Center''', though the facility's indoor waiting area was not completed until later that year. The indoor waiting facility at the station was the third to be built by DART after [[Downtown Irving/Heritage Crossing station|South Irving Transit Center]] and [[Trinity Mills station|North Carrolton Transit Center]].{{Cite news |last=Kelley |first=Chris |date=1989-01-30 |title=DART Geared Up for Big Week |url=https://infoweb.newsbank.com/apps/news/openurl?ctx_ver=z39.88-2004&rft_id=info%3Asid/infoweb.newsbank.com&svc_dat=WORLDNEWS&req_dat=0FC00B934DD580D0&rft_val_format=info%3Aofi/fmt%3Akev%3Amtx%3Actx&rft_dat=document_id%3Anews%252F0ED3D05445873918 |work=[[The Dallas Morning News]] |publisher=[[DallasNews Corporation|A. H. Belo Corporation]] |pages=13A |via=[[NewsBank]]}} Ridership at the east Plano facility was not substantially affected by West Plano Transit Center's opening. In response, DART opted to build an expanded east Plano facility,{{Cite news |date=1989-06-24 |title=City Council to hold DART hearing Monday - Members seek comment on new service plan |url=https://infoweb.newsbank.com/apps/news/openurl?ctx_ver=z39.88-2004&rft_id=info%3Asid/infoweb.newsbank.com&svc_dat=WORLDNEWS&req_dat=0FC00B934DD580D0&rft_val_format=info%3Aofi/fmt%3Akev%3Amtx%3Actx&rft_dat=document_id%3Anews%252F0ED3D07A5BB4251D |work=[[The Dallas Morning News]] |publisher=[[DallasNews Corporation|A. H. Belo Corporation]] |pages=2G |via=[[NewsBank]]}} which opened in 1992 as [[Parker Road station|East Plano Transit Center]]. On September 25, 1993, a shuttle route established between West Plano Transit Center and [[Texas Stadium]] for a [[Garth Brooks]] concert suffered higher-than expected demand, leaving many fans stranded at the station. The incident led to DART reviewing their event shuttle policies.{{Cite news |last=Yearwood |first=John |date=1993-10-06 |title=DART reviewing shuttle service to big events - Brooks concert problems prompt action |url=https://infoweb.newsbank.com/apps/news/openurl?ctx_ver=z39.88-2004&rft_id=info%3Asid/infoweb.newsbank.com&svc_dat=WORLDNEWS&req_dat=0FC00B934DD580D0&rft_val_format=info%3Aofi/fmt%3Akev%3Amtx%3Actx&rft_dat=document_id%3Anews%252F0ED3D3B8EFF25003 |work=[[The Dallas Morning News]] |publisher=[[DallasNews Corporation|A. H. Belo Corporation]] |pages=32A |via=[[NewsBank]]}} On October 12, 2009, the station was renamed and formally dedicated in memory of Jack Hatchell, a Plano councilman and [[Collin County, TX|Collin County]] commissioner who had died the previous year. Hatchell was instrumental in Plano joining DART.{{Cite web |date=2009-10-07 |title=Jack Hatchell Transit Center to be formally dedicated |url=https://www.dart.org/about/news-and-events/newsreleases/newsrelease-detail/jack-hatchell-transit-center-to-be-formally-dedicated-879 |access-date= |website=[[Dallas Area Rapid Transit]] |language=en}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://www.dart.org/guide/transit-and-use/rail/rail-station-detail/jack-hatchell-transit-center DART - Jack Hatchell Transit Center] {{Plano, Texas}} {{Dallas Area Rapid Transit}} {{coord|33.017232|-96.76881|type:landmark|display=title}} [[Category:Dallas Area Rapid Transit]] [[Category:1989 establishments in Texas]] [[Category:Bus stations in Texas]] {{Dallas-stub}} {{Texas-transport-stub}}
